purpose: Adjudicate the smallest exact-upstream Obsidian source cohort without rewriting payloads, assuming low lifecycle cost from Skill count, or conflating manager registration with installation and activation.

skills.name: defuddle
skills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Would fetch user-supplied web URLs and proposes a global npm install when absent.
skills.reason: Missing CLI, global-install instruction, external network/data boundary, and broad web-route overlap require a later task-bound comparison.

skills.name: json-canvas
skills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Pure JSON Canvas file-format guidance; task-time file writes remain separately authorized.
skills.distinctCoverage: JSON Canvas schema, referential integrity, layout, and validation rules.
skills.reason: Dependency-complete, low executable surface, portable format guidance with distinct validation semantics.

skills.name: obsidian-bases
skills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Pure .base YAML and formula guidance; task-time vault access remains separately authorized.
skills.distinctCoverage: Obsidian Bases schema, formula, view, summary, and validation semantics.
skills.reason: Dependency-complete, low executable surface, and no current Skill supplies the same Bases reference closure.

skills.name: obsidian-cli
skills.runtimeDependency: obsidian CLI and running Obsidian instance
skills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Can read and mutate vault data and invoke application-context JavaScript through obsidian eval.
skills.reason: Missing CLI and materially broader local-application and vault authority require a task-bound dependency and permission review.

skills.name: obsidian-markdown
skills.permissionAndDataBoundary: Pure Obsidian-flavored Markdown guidance; task-time note access and writes remain separately authorized.
skills.distinctCoverage: Wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and Obsidian-specific validation semantics.
skills.reason: Dependency-complete, low executable surface, and more precise syntax coverage without imposing a vault organization model.

currentPortfolioOverlap.reason: The upstream format Skills do not reproduce the existing vault-discovery and organization workflow, while the existing workflow's incremental value is untested.

managerBoundary.nextSafeAction: Register the exact upstream repository as a discovery source, verify the discovered five-Skill snapshot against the pinned revision, and prepare a default-disabled installation mechanism or request separate transient-host activation authority.
